evidence_snippets: Adjustment rules Adjustment rules can help you refine detection accuracy by increasing (also called boosting ) or decreasing the likelihood values of findings based on the context in which they appear.
For example, you can use an adjustment rule to increase the likelihood values of GENERIC ID findings when they appear in documents that match DOCUMENT TYPE/CONTEXT/FINANCE .
